name: [TESTING] Mining GO! ⛏️
desc:
RORVIK is a cute, relaxing mining game with tons of ores and trinkets to collect! Inspired by Bee Swarm Simulator.

Explore a world full of magical ores and fantastical creatures. Climb the leaderboard and show the world how great you are at completing quests, dealing damage, and collecting tons of ores. With a whole world of mining to explore, what's not to love?

🌴 Discover all sorts of precious ores gleaming just beneath the sandy soil!
💎 Team up with friends to take on crazy boss ores!
🏝️ Explore new islands full of lore and treasure!

🫂 Join our community /bluebamboo
